title: Grain for {settlement}
The granary is bare
summary: The granary of {settlement} is nearly bare, and the builders of the {place} eat like horses. Bring {count} × {item}.
{settlement} needs {count} × {item} to feed the workers on its {place}.
offer: The harvest was thin and the {place} has a hungry crew. {count} × {item} would see them through.
We cannot build on empty bellies. {count} × {item}, if you have it.
complete: That will keep the crew fed for a week.
Bless you. The granary breathes again.
